messages.subject: blavaan ERROR: problem with MCMC estimation.
messages.subject_clean: blavaan ERROR: problem with MCMC estimation.
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Could anyone be so kind to tell me what I am doing wrong? I'm doing a simulation study on longitudinal structural equation modelling  and I'm trying to use bgrowth from blavaan but I always get some error. I have spent couple of days trying new things but nothing seems to work. I have only one prior which is for the intercept has a normal distributio with mean 45.17279 and standard deviation of 27.08923 (but according to this website I'm suppose to use standard deviation for prior if I am using stan https://www.rensvandeschoot.com/bayesian-regression-in-blavaan-using-stan/)  This is the error I usually get:
This is blavaan 0.3-4
Warning message:
In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated ov variances are negative
DIAGNOSTIC(S) FROM PARSER:
Info (non-fatal):
Left-hand side of sampling statement (~) may contain a non-linear transform o                                                                                f a parameter or local variable.
If it does, you need to include a target += statement with the log absolute d                                                                                eterminant of the Jacobian of the transform.
Left-hand-side of sampling statement:
    eta ~ sem_lv_lpdf(...)

Compiling stan model...DIAGNOSTIC(S) FROM PARSER:
Info (non-fatal):
Left-hand side of sampling statement (~) may contain a non-linear transform o                                                                                f a parameter or local variable.
If it does, you need to include a target += statement with the log absolute d                                                                                eterminant of the Jacobian of the transform.
Left-hand-side of sampling statement:
    eta ~ sem_lv_lpdf(...)

Error in system2(file.path(R.home(component = "bin"), "R"), args = paste("CMD                                                                                 config",  :
  error in running command
Error in blavaan(QB, data = simulated, test = "none", dp = dpriors(nu = "norm                                                                                al(45.17279, 27.08923)",  :
  blavaan ERROR: problem with MCMC estimation.  The model syntax and data hav                                                                                e been exported.
Calls: bgrowth -> eval -> eval -> blavaan
Execution halted

My code is in the attachment.
Best regards,
Jóhanna Margrét Sigurðardóttir

messages.subject: Re: blavaan ERROR: problem with MCMC estimation.
messages.subject_clean: blavaan ERROR: problem with MCMC estimation.
messages.body_plain:
Johanna

I fail to replicate the error, the model runs fine for me, with the version blavaan_0.3-5.403, you can install the development version with
install.packages("blavaan", repos="http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee", type="source")

Also, your prior on nu is actually not doing anything since nu is the intercept for the manifest variables, which are fix to 0 for the growth model. If you want to set the prior for the latent variable means, you need to set it on alpha

Lastly, I would recommend to delete this from your model
t1 ~~t2
t2 ~~ t3
t3 ~~ t4
t4 ~~ t5
t5 ~~ t6
t6 ~~ t7
t7 ~~ t8
t8 ~~ t9
t9 ~~ t10

This seems to set a simplex structure between the residuals. But you already have a time dependency between the items with the growth model, so adding this extra time dependency between items results is a negative residual variance with lavaan. This would be needed if there were a time dependency above and beyond the growth model, which I dont see in your data simulation

Hope this helps

messages.body_plain:
I have not tried to run the code yet, but I think the line would be
something like

i ~ prior("normal(45.2, 27.1)")*1

instead of your current

i ~ 1

You don't need the target="stan" thing if you are setting a prior
directly within the model specification syntax.

Ed

messages.subject: Summer stats camp
messages.body_plain:
Hi all

I am part of the group that works on the Stats Camp (www.statscamp.org <http://www.statscamp.org>) which offers a variety of week long stats courses in June. Several courses are center around SEM, and offer code material in lavaan.

I teach the Bayesian SEM course, for which I use blavaan, as it is the best BSEM program

Hope to see some of you there
